case_name: Azizuddin v Board of Revenue and Others

statutes.act: Read With Section 7 Of The 1954 Act
Under The Bhopal State Land Revenue Act

holding: Not only the aforesaid sections were held to be ultra vires but even notice of demand was also held to be illegal.
All actions taken or act done on account of eradication of kans stood declared as lawful and confirmed and is deemed valid as if they have been done in accordance with law.
cases_cited: also declared illegal in the case of State of Bhopal and Ors. Vs. Champalal
